name: Google OAuth 2.0
description: Server-side Google OAuth 2.0: authorization code flow, userinfo fetch, AES-256-GCM session cookie, optional hosted-domain restriction, and a root middleware that protects configured paths while still honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.

questions.prompt: Restrict to Google Workspace domain? (leave blank for any Google account)
Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)?

checklist: Create OAuth 2.0 credentials at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials (Web application type)
Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from the Google Cloud Console
Set AUTH_MODE=real (or unset AUTH_MODE) — this template's middleware.ts overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware and runs real Google auth on protected paths
Keep AUTH_MODE=mock for local dev — both the middleware and getCurrentUser() short-circuit to MOCK_USER
Verify GET /api/auth/me returns UserContext after login
Verify POST /api/auth/logout/google clears the session cookie
Confirm middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to /api/auth/login/google for paths under {protected_paths}
Use getCurrentUser() / requireAuth() in Server Components and Server Actions
